title: GCP Cloud TPU VM variables
description: Configuration variables for GCP Cloud TPU VMs

TPU_VM_VERSION.description: Specific version of tpu-vm to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

TPU_VM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install TPU-VM. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise' or 'asdf' defers to third-party tools.

TPU_SCHEDULING_TYPE.description: Scheduling type for the TPU VM (on-demand, spot, or preemptible).

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: Type of TPU accelerator (e.g., v2-8, v3-8, v4-8, v3-32). Defines the hardware topology.

TPU_ZONE.description: GCP Zone for TPU provisioning. Must match the specific TFRC granted zone if using TFRC.

TPU_VERSION.description: TPU VM OS version (e.g., tpu-ubuntu2204-base). Ensure compatibility with TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.

TPU_COUNT.description: Number of independent TPU VMs to provision. Useful for multi-node provisioning.

TPU_USE_QUEUED_RESOURCE.description: Whether to use the Queued Resources API for provisioning to better handle capacity errors.

TPU_DATA_DISK_SIZE.description: Size of the persistent data disk in GB (optional).

TPU_DATA_DISK_TYPE.description: Type of the persistent data disk (e.g., pd-balanced).
